text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text identifies \"Federal Chancellor's staff office\" as the entity responsible for cross-departmental coordination of projects, resources, and administrative services for digital transformation, while German text attributes this task to \"DTI\" (which is not defined in the German text provided).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The task of the Federal Chancellor's staff office is to ensure the cross-departmental coordination of projects, resources and administrative services to advance the digital transformation process within the Federal Administration.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "DTI sorgt für eine departementsübergreifende Koordination der Vorhaben, Mittel und Verwaltungsleistungen mit dem Ziel einer digitalen Transformation der Bundesverwaltung.", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "English text identifies \"Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner\" as the entity with two areas of responsibility (Federal Act on Data Protection and Federal Act on Freedom of Information), while German text identifies \"Datenschutz- und Öffentlichkeitsbeauftragter\" (Federal Data Protection and Transparency Officer) with the same responsibilities, but the English text does not mention the additional interdepartmental bodies listed in the German text (Überdepartementale Gremien, Generalsekretärenkonferenz, etc.).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner has two areas of responsibility: the Federal Act on Data Protection and the Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "Der Eidgenössische Datenschutz- und Öffentlichkeitsbeauftragte ist für das Bundesgesetz über den Datenschutz und für das Bundesgesetz über das Öffentlichkeitsprinzip in der Verwaltung zuständig.", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}]}
